summary: Iteration 6 — validated 4 improvements: (1) profile photo cross-role visibility & no stale avatar/401 on session switch, (2) teacher review tray /revisiones (monitor only), (3) inline file preview modal for images/PDF in submissions + resources, (4) Google auth 401 on bad session_id and JWT sub=google-incomplete forces /perfil/completar. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass. Frontend: end-to-end monitor review flow (preview modal, close, feedback save with status Aprobada + grade badge), student sees Aprobada + feedback + submission file preview/download on Cálculo I → Taller de derivadas, student sidebar hides nav-revisiones, avatar upload switches to blob URL, logout+monitor login shows initial 'L' (no stale student photo, no /api/files 401s), monitor viewing /perfil/demo-student sees student's blob avatar, google-incomplete JWT lands on 'Completa tu perfil', monitor publishes file resource with preview-resource/download-resource/open-resource all present and inline preview modal renders image.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1215 lines — 70% over the 700-line threshold. Reviews/submissions logic (/submissions/incoming, /submissions/{id}/feedback, subject_tasks) should be extracted to routes/reviews.py; auth endpoints (register/login/demo/demo-advisor/google/me) to routes/auth.py; files/GridFS handlers to routes/files.py. This grew again in this iteration.

SubjectResources.jsx uses testid submit-resource-button but the review request expected publish-resource-{id} for existing resources (which DO exist). The naming is inconsistent: submit-resource-button (create form) vs preview-resource-{id}/download-resource-{id}/open-resource-{id} (per row). Consider unifying to publish-resource-button.
Resource form's file input has no data-testid — testers must locate it via nth query on generic input[type=file]. Add data-testid='resource-file-input'.

Backend /profile/photo returns only {picture: '/api/files/...'} but /auth/me exposes storage under 'picture'. The mixing of picture=absolute-api-path vs storage_path in other endpoints is inconsistent; consider always returning both {picture, storage_path} for clients that want to build blob URLs.
test_iteration6 warns InsecureKeyLengthWarning: JWT_SECRET 'uao-conecta-development-secret' is 30 bytes (<32). Non-blocking but should be rotated to a 32+ byte secret before production.
